alt: Female reproductive system in two panels (OpenStax) - (a) lateral view labelling bladder, pubic symphysis, mons pubis, urethra, clitoris, labia minora and majora, uterus, ovary, fornix, cervix, rectum, vagina and anus; (b) anterior view labelling fimbriae, uterus, uterine tube, cervix, vagina, labia, ovary, ovarian ligament and broad ligament.
